subject: Next steps: MAP checkpoints, trial ramp & revised pricing (proposal v3)
messages:
From: Jordan King <j.king@acmecloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation plan + MAP kickoff for Redwood inference

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Acme is keen to run a 6‑week evaluation of Redwood against our high-throughput inference use case. Can you send a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out checkpoints, deliverables, and a recommended ramp/commit cadence? We also need an initial ballpark on pricing and any required minimum commitments to secure the dedicated capacity during the trial window.

Our procurement and security teams will review; I’m looping Evan (engineer) and procurement in follow ups.

Appreciate a MAP + pricing by early next week if possible — we want to target a decision by the end of May.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Platforms, Acme Cloud
Acme Cloud

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan King <j.king@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan + MAP kickoff for Redwood inference

Jordan —

Thanks — attached is a draft MAP and a starter pricing grid that maps milestones to commit levels. High level:
- 6‑week evaluation split into Prep (week 0), Ramp (weeks 1–3), Hold/Optimize (weeks 4–5), Executive review (week 6)
- Checkpoints at end of week 1 (connect + small-scale validation), week 3 (throughput SLOs, cost targets), week 6 (final acceptance + rollout plan)
- Proposed anchor: 1.5M token-months committed over 3 months post‑trial to secure burst/dedicated headroom; alternative is a month‑to‑month reserved pool with a smaller minimum commit.

Attachment: MAP-Acme-v1.pdf (draft MAP)
Attachment: pricing-grid-v1.xlsx (pricing + commit options)

Key asks from Acme for the MAP to stick: test data access window, a POC contact, and a simple success metric (p95 latency < 200ms for 99% of requests during peak). If you confirm those, we’ll iterate pricing and add legal + procurement-ready language.

I’ll start a parallel internal thread for approvals but wanted to get this to you fast.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-Acme-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: pricing-grid-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Evaluation plan + MAP kickoff for Redwood inference — pricing ask

Team —

Looping you on Acme's request. They want a 6‑week eval and have asked for a firm commit option to reserve capacity during/after the trial. Two pricing options in the attached:
1) Anchor commit (preferred): 1.5M token‑months over 3 months post‑trial.
2) Lower commit: reserved pool + burst credits, smaller minimum, higher per‑token rate.

Commercial asks: can we offer a ramp discount (10% year‑one credits) conditioned on MAP checkpoints (week 3 performance + week 6 acceptance)? Legal will need a simple SOW + procurement language.

Can we get approval to present a conditional 10% ramp discount if they commit to the anchor and hit the week‑3 KPI? If not, what’s the max discount we can approve under a 3‑month reserved contract? Also note Acme flagged procurement review and timing — they want a decision by month end.

Connor

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Evaluation plan + MAP kickoff for Redwood inference — pricing ask

Connor —

I reviewed the MAP and pricing grid. Conditional approach sounds reasonable. Approve the following commercial position:
- Offer a conditional 10% ramp discount (applies once week‑3 checkpoint met and week‑6 acceptance completed).
- Commit term: 3 months post‑trial; include a break clause with 30‑day notice if SLA targets are not met.
- Price v2: slightly higher per‑token on the low‑commit option; anchor gets the best unit economics.

Please attach the updated pricing as Pricing‑proposal‑v2.pdf and ask legal to prepare a short SOW and acceptance criteria. Naomi, please run a light contract review (security clauses + data access window).

Marissa
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-proposal-v2.pdf]

From: Jordan King <j.king@acmecloud.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan + MAP kickoff for Redwood inference — comments

Connor —

Thanks for the update and MAP v1. A few comments from the engineering team:
- Week‑3 checkpoint: can we add a mid‑week performance checkpoint (end of week 2) to validate KV cache behavior under burst?
- Ramp cadence: they prefer a slower ramp for the first 2 weeks (50% of target traffic) then 100% in week 3 if stable.
- Procurement asked for a PO template and a sample SOW upfront so legal can run review in parallel.

If you can incorporate the mid‑week check and send an updated pricing v3 + final MAP by next Tuesday, procurement can expedite. I’m copying procurement here (procurement@acmecloud.com).

Regards,
Jordan

[Attachment: MAP-Acme-comments.pdf]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP checkpoint / pricing v3 — approval to finalize

Connor / Marissa —

I've reviewed the requested adjustments: added mid‑week (end of week 2) checkpoint, updated ramp cadence, and tightened acceptance criteria around p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens. Legal (Naomi) confirmed standard SOW language is fine; Sales Ops (Marissa) has signed off on the conditional 10% ramp discount tied to week‑3 KPI and week‑6 acceptance.

Approve moving to final documents: MAP‑Acme‑final.pdf and Pricing‑v3.xlsx. Please send to Jordan and procurement with a DocuSign link and PO template. Target: finalize signatures by 05/31 to meet their end‑of‑month decision window.

Karthik
VP, Sales
[Attachment: MAP-Acme-final.pdf]
[Attachment: pricing-v3.xlsx]

--
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan King <j.king@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@acmecloud.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan + MAP kickoff for Redwood inference — final docs

Jordan —

Thanks — attached are the final MAP and pricing (v3) reflecting the mid‑week checkpoint and ramp cadence. We’ve included a short SOW and a PO template per procurement's request. Pls review — I’ve also included a DocuSign link for the purchase commitment: https://docusign.com/embedded/ACME-2026-01

Quick summary of the commercial terms:
- Anchor commit: 1.5M token‑months over 3 months post‑trial; conditional 10% ramp discount on attainment of week‑3 KPI and week‑6 acceptance.
- Mid‑week (end of week 2) performance validation added to MAP.
- Break clause: 30‑day notice if SLA targets not met during demo.

Attachments: MAP-Acme-final.pdf, pricing-v3.xlsx, PO-template.docx

If procurement confirms, we’ll route DocuSign for signatures and schedule the kickoff for the following Monday.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-Acme-final.pdf]
[Attachment: pricing-v3.xlsx]
[Attachment: PO-template.docx]
